messages:
Connor O'Brien: putting together rollout plan for the KMS rotation changes this week. want to align sequencing + flags + canary tenants before we flip anything beyond staging.

Connor O'Brien: current PR stack (pls confirm status):
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28741 (cb + retry/backoff)
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28788 (key-version pinning)
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28805 (audit events)
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28822 (dual-read window)
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28873 (failure injection hooks)
- https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/28910 (tenant KMS health endpoint)

Benji Okafor: :thumbsup: on sequencing. reminder: we should keep each behavioral change behind separate flags, then have a "bundle" flag for staged rollout.

Benji Okafor: proposing flags:
- `kms.cb.enabled` (default on in staging, off prod)
- `kms.config.key_version_pinning` (default on staging, off prod)
- `kms.rotation.dual_read_enabled` (default off everywhere)
- `kms.audit.emit_events` (default on staging + canary)
- `kms.chaos.enable_hooks` (staging only)

Benji Okafor: plus one guardrail flag: `kms.decrypt.fallback_to_old.max_attempts=1` (so dual-read doesn't turn into unbounded retries)

Ethan Park: control plane side: key-version pinning will error if tenant config has `key_id` without `key_version` (in Private esp). PR 28788 includes migration logic but it still needs a "warn-only" phase.

Ethan Park: suggestion:
1) ship schema w/ validation in WARN mode for 1 release
2) start logging `unsafe_kms_config=true` per tenant
3) then enforce hard-fail for new configs only

Marcus Lin: +1. security side: we can’t brick existing Private installs because they don't have key version pinned yet. needs backwards-compat contract intact.

Marcus Lin: also pls ensure "emergency rotation" path doesn't require a deploy (should be config-only + runbook).

Kevin Osei: audit events PR (28805) is ready but needs confirm on retention routing. currently emitting:
- `kms.encrypt.success` / `kms.encrypt.failure`
- `kms.decrypt.success` / `kms.decrypt.failure`
- `kms.key.selected` (key_id + key_version)
- `kms.policy.denied` (sanitized)

Kevin Osei: all fields sanitized (no plaintext, no ciphertext). tenant_id hashed in shared logs, raw tenant_id only in audit pipeline.

Allison Grant: for canary: I need a concrete list of tenants/envs so dashboards can be filtered. metrics in 28741 + 28822 look good but alerts need tuning (don’t page on a single blip).

Allison Grant: proposed paging signals (prod):
- `kms_call_error_rate{op="decrypt"} > 0.5% for 10m` (page)
- `kms_circuit_breaker_open{}` sustained > 2m (page)
- `p95 kms_call_latency_ms > 1500ms for 15m` (ticket)

Sean Gallagher: for canary envs: i'd like one Hosted canary + one Dedicated pool + one Private staging cluster.

Sean Gallagher: candidates:
- Hosted: `tenant_ri_internal_tools` (low risk, internal)
- Dedicated: `dedicated-canary-usw2` (our dogfood)
- Private: `private-canary-01` (staging cluster in CI)

Naomi Feldman: ok w/ those. pls ensure any customer-facing changes (docs/FAQ) stay behind comms approval. we can do internal canary first without comms.

Kira Thompson: docs PR 1187 is almost ready but we’re still splitting public vs restricted sections. need final naming for flags + "rotation complete" definition.

Elliot Price: +1. we should not reference internal flag keys in public docs. we can say "enable dual-read window" and "pin key versions" generically.

Vikram Singh: dataplane note: circuit breaker + adaptive backoff is safe to default ON in prod if thresholds are conservative. biggest risk is breaker opening too aggressively -> elevated decrypt failures.

Emily Zhao: in 28741 we set breaker to open on `>= 10 failures / 30s` and half-open after 60s. also added jittered exponential backoff capped at 2s.

Rafael Mendes: can we do a partial rollout order: cb first (safe), then audit events, then key-version pinning WARN-only, then dual-read only in canary.

Benji Okafor: yep. also we should gate dual-read on an allowlist of tenants so we can toggle only for the canaries:
- `kms.rotation.dual_read_tenant_allowlist=[...]`

Connor O'Brien: ok, drafting release checklist here for sign-off. pls comment if anything missing.

Connor O'Brien: Release checklist (KMS rotation hardening)
1) Code merged to main:
   - [ ] 28741 cb/retry (merged?)
   - [ ] 28805 audit events (merged?)
   - [ ] 28788 key-version pinning (merged?)
   - [ ] 28822 dual-read (merged?)
   - [ ] 28910 health endpoint (merged?)
2) Feature flags configured:
   - [ ] staging defaults: cb=ON, audit=ON, pinning=WARN, dual-read=OFF, chaos=ON
   - [ ] prod defaults: cb=ON (after 24h staging), audit=OFF->ON canary, pinning=WARN, dual-read=OFF
   - [ ] dual-read allowlist set for: tenant_ri_internal_tools, dedicated-canary-usw2
3) Canary plan:
   - [ ] deploy to staging, run failure-mode suite (timeouts/throttles/AccessDenied) using chaos hooks
   - [ ] prod canary 1% traffic / allowlisted tenants for 24h
   - [ ] expand to 10% traffic after alerts clean
4) Observability / SRE readiness:
   - [ ] dashboards updated (kms latency/errors, cache hit, breaker state)
   - [ ] alerts enabled w/ agreed thresholds
   - [ ] runbook link verified (kms dependency degradation)
5) Security/GRC:
   - [ ] audit event schema reviewed by Marcus/Olga team
   - [ ] breakglass policy referenced in runbook
6) Docs:
   - [ ] internal ops doc updated w/ flag names
   - [ ] public docs updated w/o internal flag names

Marcus Lin: looks good. add one item: confirm dual-read fallback is bounded and logs key ids + versions (for incident triage). we need evidence we’re not silently drifting.

Kevin Osei: audit events cover key selection (key_id + key_version). dual-read path also emits `kms.decrypt.fallback_old_key_used=true` metric + event (in 28822).

Allison Grant: pls add "check alert routing" (pagerduty service + oncall schedule) before prod canary. we’ve been burned.

Sean Gallagher: also add explicit rollback triggers:
- if decrypt error rate > 0.2% sustained for 5m on canary -> disable dual-read allowlist + audit emit, keep cb on
- if breaker opens cluster-wide -> lower breaker sensitivity via config + page SRE

Benji Okafor: can implement rollback w/ a single "kill switch" flag too:
- `kms.rollout.global_disable_new_behavior` => forces dual-read OFF + audit OFF + pinning enforcement OFF

Ethan Park: careful: pinning enforcement OFF is fine, but schema changes are in config validation path. we can set to WARN mode and keep it there.

Kira Thompson: for docs: please confirm terminology:
- "scheduled rotation" = planned key version update, dual-read window
- "emergency rotation" = immediate switch + shorter dual-read, plus incident process

Marcus Lin: yes. emergency rotation should default to shorter window + require breakglass approval if customer-managed key policy changes are needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `control-plane` -> staging at 13:00 PT (commit 8c71d2f)

Connor O'Brien: ok, propose timeline:
- Today: merge 28805 + 28910 if green
- Tomorrow AM: staging deploy w/ cb+audit+pinning(warn)
- Tomorrow PM: staging chaos tests (28873) + verify dashboards
- Next day: prod canary allowlist enable audit + dual-read (for internal only)

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: for chaos tests we’ll run:
- 5m of 50% KMS timeouts
- 5m of throttling responses
- 5m AccessDenied for decrypt
expectation: breaker opens, app errors remain bounded, recovery w/in 2m once chaos off.

incident-bot: Reminder template updated for KMS incidents: include `key_id`, `key_version`, `breaker_state`, `error_code`, `region`, `tenant_allowlist` (ref PR https://github.com/redwood/incident-bot/pull/221)

Allison Grant: also want to validate that enabling audit emit doesn't spike log volume too much. pls watch `audit_pipeline_lag_seconds`.

Kevin Osei: audit events are sampled for `success` (1%), not for `failure` (100%). volume should be fine.

Connor O'Brien: cool. canary tenants confirmed:
- Hosted: tenant_ri_internal_tools
- Dedicated: dedicated-canary-usw2
Private stays staging-only for now (until installer preflight lands + docs)

Elliot Price: :eyes: pls ensure private docs call out IAM propagation delays + region mismatch. we keep seeing that.

Sean Gallagher: last ask: who’s DRI to sit on canary monitoring window?

Connor O'Brien: SRE: Sean (primary), Rafael (backup). Eng: Emily (kms client), Ethan (control plane). Security: Kevin (audit) on standby. Marcus only if escalation.

Marcus Lin: works. page me only if decrypt failures suggest key mismatch / policy denial, or if emergency rotation considered.

Benji Okafor: i’ll prep the flag configs + allowlist, will post in #eng-releases once applied.

Connor O'Brien: awesome. i’ll copy this checklist into release ticket and schedule the go/no-go tomorrow after staging chaos pass.
